calculators.name: cap_rate
calculators.label: Cap rate
calculators.description: The yield on an unlevered purchase: NOI divided by price.

calculators.name: value_from_cap_rate
calculators.label: Value at a target cap rate
calculators.description: What a buyer using a different cap rate would pay for the same income.

calculators.name: gross_rent_multiplier
calculators.label: Gross rent multiplier
calculators.description: Price divided by gross annual rent. Lower is cheaper; it ignores expenses entirely.

calculators.name: price_to_rent
calculators.label: Price-to-rent ratio
calculators.description: Months of rent it takes to buy the property. Above 240 months, renting is usually right.

calculators.name: one_percent_rule
calculators.label: The 1% rule
calculators.description: Monthly rent as a share of price. At or above 1% a deal usually carries itself.
calculators.notes: A blunt screen. It ignores taxes, insurance and the condition of the roof.

calculators.name: fifty_percent_rule
calculators.label: The 50% rule
calculators.description: The expenses half of a small rental, before the mortgage. A quick sanity check on a rent roll.

calculators.name: gross_rent_multiplier_band
calculators.label: Is this price in the market's range?
calculators.description: Compare against the gross-rent multiple your market actually trades at.

calculators.name: monthly_payment
calculators.label: Monthly mortgage payment
calculators.description: Principal and interest on an amortising loan.

calculators.name: payment_from_months
calculators.label: Payment for a fixed term
calculators.description: The same loan quoted in months rather than years.

calculators.name: loan_from_payment
calculators.label: How much can I borrow?
calculators.description: The loan a given monthly payment supports.

calculators.name: loan_constant
calculators.label: Loan constant
calculators.description: Annual debt service as a share of the loan. Compare it to the cap rate to see whether leverage helps or hurts.

calculators.name: total_interest
calculators.label: Total interest over the life of the loan
calculators.description: Interest paid in total, and what paying extra saves.

calculators.name: interest_saved_by_extra
calculators.label: What one extra payment a month saves
calculators.description: Interest saved and time cut from the loan.

calculators.name: balance_after
calculators.label: Loan balance after n months
calculators.description: What you would still owe at a given point — the number the refinance depends on.

calculators.name: pmi_monthly
calculators.label: PMI
calculators.description: Private mortgage insurance, charged while the loan is above 80% of value.

calculators.name: months_until_pmi_drops
calculators.label: Months until PMI falls away
calculators.description: Assumes the value does not move. Appreciation gets you there sooner; a reappraisal proves it.

calculators.name: points_cost
calculators.label: Cost of discount points
calculators.description: One point is one per cent of the loan.

calculators.name: rate_buydown_payback
calculators.label: Months to break even on a rate buydown
calculators.description: How long the lower payment takes to repay the points, and whether you will hold that long.

calculators.name: blended_rate
calculators.label: Blended rate across loans
calculators.description: The single rate that costs the same as a set of loans.
calculators.notes: Senior debt at 6.5% plus seller financing at 9.5% is a common stack.

calculators.name: gross_potential_rent
calculators.label: Gross potential rent
calculators.description: A full year of rent with every unit occupied and every tenant paying.

calculators.name: effective_gross_income
calculators.label: Effective gross income
calculators.description: What the building actually collects: rent less vacancy and bad debt, plus fees and parking.

calculators.name: operating_expenses
calculators.label: Operating expenses, itemised
calculators.description: The lines a lender's underwriter would look for, rather than one opaque number.

calculators.name: expense_ratio
calculators.label: Operating expense ratio
calculators.description: Expenses as a share of collections. Compare against the benchmark for the asset class.

calculators.name: noi
calculators.label: Net operating income
calculators.description: The number the cap rate is applied to, before debt service and before tax.

calculators.name: breakeven_occupancy
calculators.label: Break-even occupancy
calculators.description: How full the building has to be to pay its bills and the mortgage. A cushion, in a single number.

calculators.name: dscr
calculators.label: Debt service coverage ratio
calculators.description: NOI over debt service. Lenders want 1.25 on commercial and 1.15 on a DSCR rental loan.

calculators.name: debt_yield
calculators.label: Debt yield
calculators.description: The lender's own yield: NOI over loan. Usually 9% to 10% on commercial debt.

calculators.name: cash_on_cash
calculators.label: Cash-on-cash return
calculators.description: Cash flow on the cash you put in. The number that decides whether the deal is worth doing.

calculators.name: cash_invested
calculators.label: Total cash to close
calculators.description: Everything that leaves your account before the first rent cheque.

calculators.name: payback_years
calculators.label: Years to get your cash back
calculators.description: Undiscounted payback. Crude, and still the fastest way to compare two deals.

calculators.name: equity_multiple
calculators.label: Equity multiple
calculators.description: Every dollar out divided by every dollar in, across the whole hold.

calculators.name: average_annual_return
calculators.label: Compound annual return from a multiple
calculators.description: The compound annual rate that turns your money into a multiple over the hold — a 2.5x over ten years is 9.6% a year, not the 15% that dividing by ten would suggest.

calculators.name: total_return
calculators.label: Total return with appreciation and paydown
calculators.description: The three engines of a rental added up: cash flow, appreciation, and the tenant paying down your loan.

calculators.name: irr
calculators.label: Internal rate of return
calculators.description: The discount rate at which the deal is worth exactly what you paid. Use the sign convention: money out is negative.

calculators.name: npv
calculators.label: Net present value
calculators.description: What the deal is worth to you today at your own cost of capital.

calculators.name: mirr
calculators.label: Modified IRR
calculators.description: IRR with cash flow reinvested at a rate you can actually get, and financing at a rate you can actually borrow at.

calculators.name: depreciable_basis
calculators.label: Depreciable basis
calculators.description: The part of the purchase you are allowed to depreciate. Land is never depreciable, and the assessment roll is the best evidence of the split.

calculators.name: straight_line_annual
calculators.label: Annual straight-line depreciation
calculators.description: 27.5 years for residential, 39 for commercial. A paper loss that shelters real cash flow.

calculators.name: annual_depreciation
calculators.label: First-year depreciation with mid-month convention
calculators.description: Property placed in service mid-month gets only part of the first year, and a corresponding tail at the end.

calculators.name: depreciation_taken_over_hold
calculators.label: Depreciation over the hold
calculators.description: The cumulative deduction, which is also the unrecaptured section 1250 gain you will owe tax on at sale.

calculators.name: cost_segregation_benefit
calculators.label: Cost segregation benefit
calculators.description: A study that moves part of the building into five- and seven-year property so it can be written off now. The benefit is real only if you have the income to shield.
calculators.notes: Watch the depreciation recapture on the way out — this borrows from your exit, it does not forgive.

calculators.name: sale_gain_components
calculators.label: What you owe when you sell
calculators.description: The gain split into its parts, because they are taxed at different rates.

calculators.name: capital_gains_tax
calculators.label: Capital gains tax on a sale
calculators.description: Depreciation you claimed is taxed back at up to 25%, which is why a cost segregation study is a loan against your exit rather than a gift.

calculators.name: niit
calculators.label: Net investment income tax
calculators.description: The 3.8% surtax on investment income above the threshold. Passive rental income counts.
calculators.notes: It also pushes you over the threshold where passive losses stop being deductible.

calculators.name: passive_loss_allowed
calculators.label: Passive loss I can actually deduct
calculators.description: The $25,000 allowance, phased out between $100,000 and $150,000 of income. Above that, losses suspend and wait.

calculators.name: qbi_deduction
calculators.label: Qualified business income deduction
calculators.description: Up to 20% of rental income, if the rental rises to the level of a trade or business. The 250-hour test is the usual route.

calculators.name: section_121_exclusion
calculators.label: Section 121 exclusion
calculators.description: The gain you can exclude on a home you lived in two of the last five years. House hackers should plan around it.

calculators.name: section_1031_deferral
calculators.label: Section 1031 deferral
calculators.description: Sell one property and buy another, and the tax waits. This is the single most powerful tool in the sample for compounding equity instead of paying for the privilege of selling.

calculators.name: opportunity_zone_deferral
calculators.label: Qualified opportunity zone
calculators.description: Defer the gain and, on the original rules, step up the basis. Confirm current law before relying on the exclusion at ten years.

calculators.name: step_up_basis_benefit
calculators.label: Step-up in basis at death
calculators.description: The reason generational wealth in property is different: gains you never realise are never taxed, and your heirs start again from the value at your death.

calculators.name: estate_tax
calculators.label: Federal estate tax
calculators.description: Forty per cent above the exemption, and property is illiquid, which is why the estate tax is really a liquidity problem.

calculators.name: gift_and_annual_exclusion
calculators.label: Annual gift exclusion
calculators.description: Giving away $19,000 a year per recipient costs nothing and compounds outside your estate.

calculators.name: tax_assumptions
calculators.label: Current tax assumptions
calculators.description: Every rate and limit the engine uses, in one place, with the date it was checked.

calculators.name: size_loan
calculators.label: How much will the lender give me?
calculators.description: Loan proceeds are set by the tightest of three tests — loan-to-value, debt service coverage, and debt yield. Which one binds tells you what the deal is really about.

calculators.name: max_loan_by_dscr
calculators.label: Loan by DSCR test
calculators.description: The loan whose debt service the income covers, with the required cushion.

calculators.name: max_loan_by_debt_yield
calculators.label: Loan by debt yield test
calculators.description: The lender's floor on return regardless of the interest rate, which is why it binds hardest when rates are low.

calculators.name: dscr_after_rate_move
calculators.label: What a rate move does to coverage
calculators.description: Coverage at a higher rate. On floating-rate debt this is the question that decides whether you can hold through a bad year.

calculators.name: yield_on_cost
calculators.label: Yield on cost
calculators.description: Stabilised income over everything you spent, capital included. In a value-add, this is the number that has to beat the exit cap rate.

calculators.name: development_spread
calculators.label: Development spread
calculators.description: The gap a developer is paid for taking construction risk. Below 150 basis points, the risk is not being paid for.

calculators.name: value_add_analysis
calculators.label: Value-add: what the capital is worth
calculators.description: The whole value-add story in one screen: what you spend, what the income becomes, what it sells for, and the spread you were paid for the work.

calculators.name: cash_out_refinance
calculators.label: Cash-out refinance
calculators.description: Pulling your capital back out without selling — the move that turns one property into two. It also raises the debt service you have to cover.

calculators.name: equity_waterfall
calculators.label: Partnership waterfall
calculators.description: How cash splits between the money and the work, tier by tier, after the preferred return.

calculators.name: sources_and_uses
calculators.label: Sources and uses
calculators.description: Where every dollar comes from and where every dollar goes. Lenders and partners both start here.

calculators.name: walt
calculators.label: Weighted average lease term
calculators.description: How long the income is contractually locked. Short WALT means the exit cap rate should be wider.

calculators.name: lease_rollover_exposure
calculators.label: Rent rolling over
calculators.description: The share of income that has to be re-let inside a window — the risk a lender will ask about.

calculators.name: nnn_effective_rent
calculators.label: Net effective rent on an NNN lease
calculators.description: What the landlord actually keeps after leakage in the CAM reconciliation. Recoveries leak.

calculators.name: stabilized_occupancy_needed
calculators.label: Occupancy needed to cover debt
calculators.description: The occupancy the building must hold to service its debt, before any cushion.

calculators.name: loan_to_cost
calculators.label: Loan to cost
calculators.description: For construction and value-add, cost is the right denominator rather than value.

calculators.name: expense_stop_rent
calculators.label: Expense stop rent
calculators.description: The increase over the base year that the tenant pays on top of rent.

calculators.name: rent_to_income
calculators.label: Rent as a share of area income
calculators.description: Above 30% and the rent is at the limit of what the neighbourhood can absorb.

calculators.name: cap_rate_spread_to_treasury
calculators.label: Cap rate spread over Treasuries
calculators.description: Why cap rates sit where they do: the spread over the risk-free rate is what a buyer demands for taking property risk.

calculators.name: monthly_carry
calculators.label: What this house costs me a month
calculators.description: The monthly gap between owning and renting it out. Negative means the tenant is covering it.
calculators.notes: Excludes tax effects and appreciation, both of which are real and neither of which pays this month's mortgage.
